injuries.name: Tyler Huntley
injuries.note: Huntley may have sustained a right turf toe injury during Sunday's 36-10 loss at Buffalo, Adam Schefter of ESPN reports.

injuries.name: Joe Fagnano
injuries.note: Fagnano acknowledged that he's not 100 percent healthy after taking a hit to his left knee during Sunday's 36-10 loss to the bills, but he said that he hopes to be ready to play in Thursday's game against the Jaguars, Jonas Shafferof TheBanner.com reports.

injuries.name: Lamar Jackson
injuries.note: Ravens head coach Jesse Minter said after Sunday's 36-10 loss to the Bills that Jackson will undergo surgery to address his right thumb injury and will be placed on injured reserve,  Brian Wacker of The Baltimore Sun reports.

injuries.name: Nate Wiggins
injuries.note: Wiggins (stinger) is being evaluated for a possible concussion and is questionable to return to Sunday's game against the Bills.
